$comment: Proxy-mode fixtures — spec §8.1 (exit IP, ≥2 endpoints), §8.2 (WebRTC/DNS/timezone leak), §8.3 (speed, ≥2 endpoints), §8.4 (safety), §13.7, §13.8. Consumed by tests/harness/spec13.test.mjs.

exit_ip.$comment: §8.1 — call at least TWO endpoints through the proxy and compare with the typed IP.

mismatch.$comment: §13.7 — the red-flag case. Typed 45.155.205.1, the proxy actually exits from 185.244.1.1.

expect.verdict_effect: downgrade — the exit IP is what gets scored, and the mismatch itself is surfaced

endpoints_disagree.$comment: Rotating proxy — two endpoints report two different exits.

webRTC.$comment: §8.2 + §13.8 — an ICE candidate that carries the machine's real IP (not the proxy exit) is a leak and MUST downgrade the verdict.

input_candidates: candidate:3 1 TCP 2105524479 192.168.1.42 9 typ host tcptype active
candidate:1 1 UDP 1686052607 185.244.1.1 54322 typ srflx raddr 0.0.0.0 rport 0

no_proxy.$comment: §1.2 — ip_only mode must never invent measurements.

expect.display_text: Chưa đo được — cần nhập proxy

dns_leak.$comment: §8.2 — document the method (SOCKS5 remote DNS vs HTTP CONNECT) and never overclaim (DoH blind spot).

timezone_consistency.$comment: §8.2 — browser timezone must line up with the exit IP timezone.

headless_flags.$comment: §8.2 — warn only, never the sole verdict input.

ja3.$comment: §8.2 — JA3 is optional and low-confidence. If it cannot be fetched through the proxy, the field stays null with a reason. NEVER fabricate.

speed.$comment: §8.3 — ≥2 independent endpoints, download + latency + jitter. No upload unless explicitly enabled.

expect.display_text: Chưa đo được — cần nhập proxy

safety_8_4.$comment: §8.4 — never persist proxy credentials, never try default credentials, never leave Chromium running.
assertions: settings/SQLite/history rows for a proxy check contain proxy_host, proxy_port, proxy_protocol but NO username/password column, and no credential substring appears in any row
history JSON export of a proxy check contains no 'password', 'passwd', 'auth', 'credential', 'user:pass' token
the proxy adapter performs exactly one connect attempt per endpoint — no fallback to empty/default credentials
after a leak run the child browser process is gone (tasklist shows no msedgewebview2/chrome child of the runner)
browser timeout is 20–30 s and a timed-out run still returns a LeakResult with an error, not a panic
